pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the letter M named in German? (1 mark)
   A. eff
   B. tset
   C. emm
   D. ee

2. How is "st" pronounced at the start of "Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. like sk
   B. like st in stone
   C. like sd
   D. like sht

3. Why do "Let's eat, Grandma" and "Let's eat Grandma" mean different things? (1 mark)
   A. One has more words
   B. The comma changes the meaning
   C. Only the capital letters differ
   D. One is in German

4. Which little word goes with the noun "Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

5. What does "das Schlafzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. clock
   C. wall
   D. bedroom

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

7. Which day comes right before Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Freitag
   C. Dienstag
   D. Montag

8. What does "jetzt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. now
   B. always
   C. yesterday
   D. often

9. What is the plural of "der Freund"? (1 mark)
   A. die Freunder
   B. die Freunden
   C. die Freunds
   D. die Freunde

10. Which day comes right before Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Samstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Montag

11. Which month comes right after "Januar"? (1 mark)
   A. Februar
   B. November
   C. Mai
   D. April

12. Which month comes right after "Juli"? (1 mark)
   A. Oktober
   B. Dezember
   C. Mai
   D. August

13. What does "warum" ask? (1 mark)
   A. When
   B. Where
   C. Who
   D. Why

14. What does "der Mais" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. banana
   B. watermelon
   C. maize
   D. tomato

15. What does "der Zahn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. back
   B. hair
   C. toe
   D. tooth

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

17. What does "kühl" mean? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. cool
   C. warm
   D. wet

18. What does "Regenzeit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. thunder
   B. rainy season
   C. rainbow
   D. dry season

19. Which verb form completes "Der Hund ___ im Garten"? (schlafen) (1 mark)
   A. schlafe
   B. schlafen
   C. schlaft
   D. schläft

20. Which German word means "in"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. unter
   C. vor
   D. neben

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)

22. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

23. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)

24. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)

25. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

26. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

27. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

28. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

29. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

30. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

31. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — emm
   In German the letter M is called emm.

2. D — like sht
   At the start of a word st sounds like sht.

3. B — The comma changes the meaning
   A comma shows a pause and can change the meaning of a sentence.

4. D — das
   It is das Kind, so the little word is das.

5. D — bedroom
   das Schlafzimmer means bedroom.

6. B — die
   It is die Wand, so the little word is die.

7. C — Dienstag
   Before Mittwoch comes Dienstag.

8. A — now
   jetzt means now.

9. D — die Freunde
   The plural of der Freund is die Freunde.

10. A — Donnerstag
   Before Freitag comes Donnerstag.

11. A — Februar
   After Januar comes Februar.

12. D — August
   After Juli comes August.

13. D — Why
   warum means why.

14. C — maize
   der Mais means maize.

15. D — tooth
   der Zahn means tooth.

16. D — das
   It is das Auge, so the little word is das.

17. B — cool
   kühl is cool.

18. B — rainy season
   Regen = rain and Zeit = time.

19. D — schläft
   schlafen changes to schläft for er, sie and es.

20. A — in
   in in German is in.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.
